{{Top|leg}}
'''Agronomy''' was the science of using [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. The [[Nuiwit]] of [[Altor 14]] almost wiped out their neighbors, the [[Avogwi]], through strategic use of agronomy by developing a [[tarpaulin plant]] that secreted an enzyme that resembled water condensation. When an Avogwi landed on the plant to take on [[Water/Legends|water]], they were stuck by the enzyme which acted as a glue. The struggle of the Avogwi tripped a [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] that closed the plant with the victim trapped inside.
